[[Strongroot's Shelter]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[shield]] dropped by [[Strongroot Tanglebranch]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Morostav Trail]].

==Stats==
:[[Armor rating|Armor]]: 16 (Requires 9 [[Strength]])
:Received [[Physical damage]] -2 (while in a [[Stance]])
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Echovald Shield]], [[dye]]d green.
